variants.title: Back to one
variants.premise: He is counting wine crates on the dock and keeps losing his place, assembled from writer-a's Counting crates, writer-b's Grapes and Gulls and reviewer's Not my crates.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. You've made me lose count again.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Twelve, thirteen... no. Back to one.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Sorry. I only want passage somewhere.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I know these crates are going on. You're not.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No captain wants the bother.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask a sailor. I pick grapes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wine. Moonrise red, the dear stuff.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is it any good?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not for the likes of us. Don't lean on it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Once, nearly. Turned green before we left the dock.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Water's for the grapes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Mind the gulls.

variants.title: Not my trouble
variants.premise: He is eating his lunch on the crates when he notices the quiver, assembled from writer-a's Shiny back, writer-b's The Quiver and reviewer's The quiver.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The worker stops chewing and stares at your back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. That's the one from the fighting pit.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: The Colosseum, yes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then you're not my trouble. You're the harbour's.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Cothon. North side of the city.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask whoever keeps the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My cousin won't shut up about them.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He hasn't got one. Go on, the capital.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No. Show the ledger man in the capital, not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've crates to count.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Thank me when you're on a ship.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Try the capital harbour.
